paragraphs: Digital technologies are part of our everyday work, but we rarely think about the resources they consume. Computers may remain running when we're not using them, applications continue working in the background, and files accumulate over time. Individually, these activities may seem insignificant, but together they contribute to unnecessary energy and resource consumption. The Digital Sustainability Companion project investigates how we can better understand these activities and reduce their environmental impact.

As part of the project, we are developing a desktop application that monitors selected computer activities and calculates a Digital Sustainability Score based on energy efficiency, storage efficiency, and digital behaviour. The application is designed to provide personalized recommendations and help users follow their progress over time. Through this research, we also want to understand whether providing people with information about their digital habits can encourage them to make more sustainable choices.
